components.name: Active Connect Button
components.description: The primary readiness and connection action.
components.css: .ds-button-active { height: 36px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-active, oklch(0.696 0.17 162.48)); color: var(--color-active-foreground, oklch(0.9793 0.0207 166.11)); font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-active:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-active, oklch(0.696 0.17 162.48)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-button-active:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-active-ring, oklch(0.696 0.17 162.48 / 20%)); }

components.name: Primary Icon Button
components.description: A compact icon action such as send or commit.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-icon" aria-label="Send"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M22 2 11 13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-icon { display: inline-grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-icon:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-button-icon:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Utility Button
components.description: A low-emphasis toolbar action that becomes tonal on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { height: 36px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Workbench Panel
components.description: The flat bordered container for one operational responsibility.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; min-height: 180px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-card-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)); box-shadow: none; } .ds-panel-header { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 700 12px/16px "Geist Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-panel-body { display: grid; min-height: 136px; place-items: center; padding: 16px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Segmented Workspace Tabs
components.description: A compact switch between sibling operational views.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-muted, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)); } .ds-tab { height: 33px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 700 12px/16px "Geist Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)) 10%, transparent); } .ds-tab.is-active { background: var(--color-background, oklch(1 0 0)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: A compact filter field for dense event and data regions.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-secondary, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)); color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-filter:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-ring, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-filter input { width: 150px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 400 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)); } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Status Readout
components.description: A compact label-and-value block for live system state.
components.css: .ds-status { border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-card-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)); } .ds-status h3 { margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px 4px; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 700 12px/16px "Geist Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-status dl { margin: 0; padding: 4px 12px 10px; } .ds-status dl div { display: flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-status dt { font: 400 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status dd { margin: 0; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 400 12px/18px "Geist Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
The Operator's Bench treats each screen as a working instrument: technical, calm, and dependable. The interface is compact and information-dense without feeling hurried; hierarchy comes from alignment, mono labels, borders, and restrained semantic color rather than decorative emphasis.

Surfaces stay quiet so state is unmistakable. Neutral panels form a stable frame; Signal Green marks readiness and action, Fault Coral marks unavailable or error states, and identity hues remain tied to agent and client roles. Controls feel instrument-like and state-explicit.
keyCharacteristics: Dual light and dark neutral work surfaces
Sans-serif actions paired with uppercase mono labels and readouts
Saturated color reserved for state and identity
Flat, bordered panels with shallow corners

rules.name: The State Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated hues are reserved for operational state and participant identity; neutral structure carries everything else.

rules.name: The Theme Is a Remap Rule
rules.body: Light and dark modes preserve hierarchy and semantic assignments rather than merely inverting pixels.

rules.name: The Quiet Canvas Rule
rules.body: Do not add decorative gradients or brand color washes to operational surfaces.

rules.name: The Readout Split Rule
rules.body: Use sans-serif type for prose and actions; use mono for terse labels, identifiers, status values, and timestamps.

rules.name: The One Working Surface Rule
rules.body: Group related tools inside one bordered panel; do not create decorative cards inside cards.

rules.name: The Flat at Rest Rule
rules.body: Core work surfaces never float; one-pixel dividers and tonal contrast define hierarchy. Shadows belong only to temporary overlays.

rules.name: The Tool, Not Toy Rule
rules.body: Keep corners shallow and functional; do not turn ordinary content, labels, or panels into pills.

rules.name: The One State, One Signal Rule
rules.body: A control's color, label, icon, and disabled treatment must agree about its operational state.

dos: Do build hierarchy from panels, alignment, tonal layers, and dividers.
Do keep status colors tied to readiness, failure, agent, and client roles.
Do use uppercase mono labels for terse categories and sans-serif type for readable instructions and actions.
Do preserve the 640px transition from resizable workspace to single-panel mobile navigation.
Do bring new custom surfaces onto these tokens before treating them as design authority.
donts: Don't use unstyled browser-default controls or the former Room lifecycle slice bar as design-system evidence.
Don't soften the console into consumer chat styling with plush message bubbles, oversized pills, or friendly gradient cards.
Don't import decorative marketing treatments such as hero-scale type, ornamental glows, or gradient backdrops into operational screens.
Don't nest decorative cards inside working panels.
Don't use saturated color as ornament; every bright hue must communicate a defined state or identity.
